effect: The processor removed suspended grit and dissolved contaminants and checked the output, completing the potable-water goal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the drinking water was most worthwhile: the explanation connected filtration, contaminant removal and checks to the first usable cup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hose felt straightforward, though the visible grit gave the step a useful purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the probe warmed the ice underground and brought a cloudy trickle up through the collection head.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear purpose, although each step offered only one combination.

continue.text: I would continue because I am curious what the expedition discovers next, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
